open OldExpressions in
theorem extractedOldExprInVars :
  NormalizedOldExpr post →
  (extractOldExprVars post).Subset
  (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars post) := by
  intro h
  change extractOldExprVars post ⊆ Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars post
  induction h <;>
    simp_all [Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars, extractOldExprVars,
      Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars]
  case app fn e m hfn he hn ihfn ihe =>
    unfold extractOldExprVars
    split
    · simp only [Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars, List.nil_append, List.Subset.refl]
    · next hf =>
      cases hn .oldPred
      exact False.elim (hf _ _ _ rfl)
    · simp_all only [imp_false, implies_true, List.append_subset, List.subset_append_of_subset_left,
    List.subset_append_of_subset_right, and_self]

edits.replacement:
simp_all only [imp_false, implies_true, List.append_subset, List.subset_append_of_subset_left,
    List.subset_append_of_subset_right, and_self]
